changes: score_dataframe assigns oracle output columns by row position to avoid pandas index-alignment bugs with filtered, shuffled, sliced, or duplicate-index DataFrames.
score_dataframe returns a schema-complete empty scored table for empty input DataFrames.
empty and all-invalid candidate batches do not require loading model artifacts.
load_oracle configures LightGBM inference with n_jobs=1 for predictable CALLM resource usage without changing predictions.
score_callm_lrrk2_candidates.py sorts by qsar_activity_score_ad_penalized by default, adds callm_lrrk2_rank, preserves callm_input_row, and supports --no_sort for order-preserving integration.
